$comment: Council of Minds routing / global configuration. This file holds ROUTER/GLOBAL configuration only: the neutral 'chambers' routing map, decision 'modes', and cross-cutting behaviour tables (costBudget, interactiveMode, enforcement). Each kind of Mind's cast lives in its own file: the advisors in settings/decision-council.config.json, the researchers in settings/research-council.config.json.

chambers.$comment: Neutral routing map. Advisors and researchers are peers; neither is subordinate. The orchestrator (council-of-minds.md, Routing) classifies each request to one of these.

chain.$comment: Compound questions ('what's the best X given the current landscape') run the researchers FIRST, then feed the Research Verdict into an advisor panel as the evidence base. Dissent is preserved at BOTH layers. See council-of-minds.md '## Chaining' and docs/chaining.md.
detect: asks what to DO but the choice depends on a current/sourced state of the world
a decision request that names recency terms or an unsettled factual premise

handoff.$comment: The research verdict is handed to the decision panel with source identity intact so advisors can cite it and contest it.
payload: Findings Cards (claim, evidence type, confidence, stance)
handoff.rule: advisors receive Findings Cards WITH source ids; they may cite a finding by id and may contest it, but must not silently discard a contested finding

crossReference.decisionVerdict: adds a 'Sourced-From' field naming the research verdict id
crossReference.researchVerdict: retained verbatim as the evidence appendix of the chained output

reEntry.$comment: Advisors may find the evidence base insufficient for a specific gap.
reEntry.effect: the named gap re-enters the researchers as a new sub-question
reEntry.why: bounded to 1 to prevent research<->decision ping-pong loops

chain.dissent: preserve BOTH the research Minority Report and the decision Minority Report in the final chained output; never collapse them

budget.$comment: One tier applies across BOTH kinds using the shared vocabulary (Minimal/Lean/Standard/High/Deep/Unlimited).
budget.rule: the selected tier configures the researchers (retrieval dimensions) AND the advisors (panel/mode/word limits) in the same run

research.$comment: Researchers — a co-equal peer routed via the top-level 'chambers' map. Full spec in settings/research-council.config.json and the Researchers section of council-of-minds.md. Referenced here only so the mode name resolves within this file.

interactiveMode.description: When true, all council sessions include checkpoints. When false (default), only triggered by 'interactive council:' or 'council this with checkpoints:'
